headline: OpenAI upgrades ChatGPT's Chrome extension to read users' open tabs
summary: OpenAI updated its ChatGPT browser extension for Chrome so that, once installed, ChatGPT can view a user's open browser tabs when tagged in the web or desktop app, letting it compare information across tabs and perform tasks for the user.

claims.statement: OpenAI updated its ChatGPT Chrome extension so ChatGPT can view a user's open browser tabs.

sources.quote: OpenAI says ChatGPT can now view your browser tabs when you tag Chrome in ChatGPT's web or desktop app
ChatGPT can now look at your Chrome tabs to do tasks for you

claims.statement: The extension lets users compare information from their open tabs.

sources.quote: The ChatGPT browser extension lets you compare information from your open tabs.
